_readme: The ordered list of Gemini models the LLM queue may spend, each with its
OWN daily allowance. The free tier meters
GenerateRequestsPerDayPerProjectPerModel-FreeTier — the 429 names the model
in its quotaDimensions — so these are independent quota islands and the
key's real daily capacity is their SUM (V-049, D-014).
ORDER IS FAILOVER ORDER, biggest island first. That is deliberate: a small
head model would switch models partway through a normal day, and 'the same
manuscript graded twice agrees' (V3's exit checkpoint) must not be broken by
our own routing. Reserves exist so a busy day degrades instead of stopping.
EVERY number here was MEASURED against a real key on 2026-07-26 with
tools/probe_gemini_quota.py — not read off documentation, which was wrong
by 70x for gemini-3.5-flash. daily_quota values are proven FLOORS (the probe
was budget-capped, so the true ceiling may be higher); re-probe to raise one.
Configuring a value above the real cap is safe but wasteful of wall-clock:
the queue closes an island the moment the API returns a per-day 429.
Admission rules for this file (both verified before adding a model):
1. It must honor responseMimeType=application/json. gemma-4-31b-it and
gemma-4-26b-a4b-it are EXCLUDED for failing this — they have large
quotas but return prose, and capacity that cannot be parsed is not
capacity.
2. vision:true only if an image call was actually verified to work —
the queue refuses to send the V-007 vision pass to a text-only model.
No '-latest' aliases: they can silently change model behind a pinned id and
may share another entry's island, double-counting capacity that isn't there.

models.note: Workhorse. Measured 2026-07-26: ~227 successful calls in one Pacific day with NO per-day 429 (200-call probe ran to completion; the probe was capped, the quota was not exhausted) at 15/min. Configured at 200 — a proven floor with margin, not a ceiling. JSON mode and an image call both verified live.
First reserve. JSON mode and an image call verified live 2026-07-26; RPD not measured, so it carries a deliberately conservative floor.
The former sole model. Measured EXACTLY 20 requests/day (quotaValue '20') on 2026-07-26 — the blocker that produced D-014. Highest quality of the pool, so it is kept as a reserve rather than dropped.
JSON mode verified live 2026-07-26; RPD and image support not measured — text-only until they are.
JSON mode verified live 2026-07-26; RPD and image support not measured — text-only until they are.
Newest Flash. RPM measured at exactly 5/min (quotaValue '5') on 2026-07-26 — hence the low rpm. JSON verified; RPD and image support not measured.
